svg.title: T07 Superbike, left side elevation, fairing cut away over the radiator and cylinder head
svg.desc: Litre-class sport bike: full fairing with ram-air intake, twin-spar aluminium frame, liquid-cooled inline-four, upside-down fork, radial calipers on twin discs, aluminium swingarm with monoshock linkage, short side silencer.
